requirements.quote: Dependabot or Renovate opens grouped update PRs weekly and security updates immediately; policy documented [type:manual]
CI fails a PR that introduces a dependency with a known critical or high vulnerability with a fix available, unless an unexpired exception exists in `infra/security/exceptions.yml` [type:unit]
Gitleaks runs in CI and as a pre-commit hook and fails on a seeded fake secret in a test branch; example env files are allow-listed explicitly [type:unit]

CodeQL and Semgrep run on PRs and weekly; custom Semgrep rules flag queries bypassing `withWorkspace`, unsafe HTML injection, outbound fetches to non-allow-listed hosts and any L5 action; each rule has a passing and a failing fixture [type:unit]
Trivy scans built images in the images workflow and fails on critical vulnerabilities with fixes; ignore entries require an expiry date [type:unit]
ZAP baseline runs against the staging-like compose stack with an authenticated test user and fails on new medium or higher alerts not listed in a reviewed suppression file [type:e2e]
ZAP is configured to target only the allow-listed staging base URL; the workflow refuses other hosts [type:unit]

`POST /v1/csp-report` accepts `application/csp-report` and `application/reports+json`, caps body at 8 KB, rate-limits per IP, strips query strings and fragments from URLs, and writes a structured log line; it never persists user content [type:api]
A deliberate CSP violation in an e2e test produces a sanitised log entry and increments a metric `csp_violations_total` visible in monitoring [type:e2e]
A weekly report workflow posts a summary of open vulnerabilities and exceptions, and expired exceptions fail the build [type:manual]
SBOMs (CycloneDX) are generated for each image and attached to the release; supply-chain signing is verified in deploy (cosign) [type:manual]
requirements.evidence: .github/workflows/images.yml (SBOM + cosign attest); deploy verification belongs to #100's deploy workflow

requirements.quote: A static check proves no L5 action type exists and no code path auto-sends, files or pays; it runs in the security workflow [type:unit]
Findings policy documented in `vuln-triage.md`: critical within 48 hours, high within 7 days, medium within 30 days; the cross-tenant suite must stay green on every PR [type:manual]

deliverables.change: Add a security-updates group (`applies-to: security-updates`) and keep the weekly grouped npm and github-actions updates; note the policy in docs.
Document dependency-update policy, audit gate and exceptions, semgrep/zap/trivy/gitleaks jobs, weekly report.

New: run `pnpm audit --prod --json`, fail on high/critical advisories that have a patched version unless an unexpired entry in infra/security/exceptions.yml matches (id, package, reason, owner, expires); fail on any expired exception. Export pure functions for tests.
Node tests for audit-gate: fix available vs not, unexpired exception passes, expired fails, malformed entry fails.
New, empty `exceptions: []` with schema comment (id, package, severity, reason, owner, expires).
Point `audit:prod` at the gate script (keep a raw `audit:prod:raw`), add scripts for semgrep fixture test if needed.
Add explicit path allowlist for `.env.example`, `.env.ci`, `infra/docker/env/*.env.example` and a fixture dir.
Add a gitleaks pre-commit command on staged files (use the gitleaks binary if installed, else the digest-pinned docker image; skip with a notice when neither exists).
Non-scanned-by-default fake secret fixture used by CI to prove the scanner fails; excluded from the main scan by explicit path allowlist only for the main scan.
Node test: allowlist covers each example env file, does not cover other paths, lefthook has gitleaks command, security.yml has seeded-secret step.

Switch audit job to the gate script; add seeded-secret gitleaks step, trivy fs scan job (config from infra/security/trivy), `pnpm check:no-l5` step, weekly report job (step summary + issue update, issues: write only on that job), keep codeql/dependency-review opt-in; run on lockfile changes and weekly.
New: Semgrep on PRs and weekly via digest-pinned docker image, rules from infra/security/semgrep, plus `semgrep --test` for fixtures. No secrets.
Custom rules: db query/raw SQL outside withWorkspace, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, fetch to non-allow-listed hosts, L5 action type.
One `*.ts`/`*.tsx` fixture per rule with `ruleid:`/`ok:` annotations (passing and failing).
Node test: every rule id has a fixture containing both `ruleid: <id>` and `ok: <id>` annotations; workflow is pinned.
Trivy config (severity CRITICAL, ignore-unfixed, ignorefile).
Ignore file (empty list) with expiry format documented.
Node test: every ignore entry has `expired_at`/expiry in future; images.yml uses config, severity CRITICAL, exit-code 1.
Use infra/security/trivy config and ignore file in the Trivy step; attach SBOM files to the GitHub release when a release/tag build, keep cosign attest.
Generate CycloneDX per image via digest-pinned Trivy; and `verify-cosign.sh` that deploy workflows call (cosign verify + verify-attestation with the repo identity).
ZAP automation plan: authenticated test user (CI-only credentials generated in the job), context limited to the allow-listed base URL, fail on medium+ not in suppression file.
Reviewed suppression file (empty with header).
Pure `assertAllowedTarget(url, allowlist)` that refuses anything but the allow-listed staging/CI-compose base URL (never production, never third-party); CLI used by the workflow.
Node tests: allowed URL passes; production host, other hosts, userinfo/port tricks, non-http all refused.

New: weekly + workflow_dispatch; launches the compose stack (compose.prod.yml style as in infra/docker/test/compose-smoke.sh), seeds a test user, runs check-target first, then ZAP baseline; fails on new medium+.

New `cspReportRouter({ logger })`: POST /csp-report (mounted under /v1) accepts application/csp-report (object) and application/reports+json (array of csp-violation reports), reads text, rejects >8 KB, strips query/fragment from document/blocked/source URLs, logs one structured line with only whitelisted fields, increments `csp_violations_total{directive}` via meter(), returns 204; invalid type/shape 415/400 problem; stores nothing.
Mount the CSP report router.
Add `/v1/csp-report` to rate-limit groups (per IP, e.g. 60/min) and a body-limit group of 8 KB.
Tests: both content types, 8 KB cap (413), per-IP rate limit (429), sanitised log, metric incremented (test metric reader), no persistence, bad shape.
Regenerate with `pnpm --filter @causedeck/api openapi:export` if the route is documented (path to be confirmed by openapi-file.test.ts).
Add `report-uri` and `report-to csp-endpoint` directives when an API report URL is configured (env-derived option); keep all existing directives.
Assert report directives present when configured and absent otherwise.
Add `Reporting-Endpoints "csp-endpoint=\"https://api.<domain>/v1/csp-report\""` to security_headers and `report-uri`/`report-to` to strict_csp; do not add a CSP to app/admin hosts.
Assert Reporting-Endpoints present and strict_csp has report-to; existing assertions unchanged.
Playwright spec: deliberate CSP violation produces a report that reaches the report route sanitised (query/fragment stripped) and the metric/log is observed.
SLA critical 48h / high 7d / medium 30d, exceptions process (exceptions.yml fields, expiry max, review), cross-tenant suite must stay green on every PR, weekly report, CSP report triage.
Vitest: run scripts/check-no-l5.ts against the repo and assert pass; reference from semgrep L5 rule docs.
Replace 'CSP report collection is #104' with the real description.

decisions.choice: Place the CSP e2e spec at e2e/tests/security/csp.spec.ts, not e2e/security/csp.spec.ts as the issue lists.
decisions.justification: e2e/playwright.config.ts:91 sets testDir './tests'; a spec outside it never runs.

decisions.choice: Run Semgrep and gitleaks through digest-pinned docker images instead of marketplace actions.
decisions.justification: .github/workflows/security.yml:34-37 documents that gitleaks-action needs a license secret; scanners must run secret-free.

decisions.choice: Keep CodeQL in security.yml opt-in via ENABLE_GHAS and add no separate codeql.yml; Semgrep (free on private repos) is the always-on SAST.
decisions.justification: docs/engineering/ci.md:104 and D-043 gate code scanning on GHAS for private repos; security.yml:60-80 already has the job.

decisions.choice: Use no new npm dependency for the gate scripts; parse exceptions.yml with a minimal parser or a YAML library already resolvable from the workspace (check `pnpm why yaml`); do not add one to the root without a catalog entry.
decisions.justification: infra/scripts/compose-dev.test.mjs:1-6 shows infra tests use only node built-ins.

decisions.choice: CSP report route is mounted inside v1Router so it inherits the request logger, per-IP rate limit and body-limit groups; anonymous principals bypass csrf.
decisions.justification: apps/api/src/middleware/cors.ts:43-53 csrf only applies to cookie principals; apps/api/src/app.ts:126-133 group maps are the extension point.
